findings.text: the production-path guard patches only Path.is_dir, Path.mkdir, Path.glob and Path.open, so a read of ~/.local/state/ambix/index-snapshots through any other Path method (exists, iterdir, stat, read_text) is not rejected; the done-when asserts the ingest path writes and reads nothing under the production directory, and while a misdirected write is still caught by the assertions at tests/test_index_placement.py:162 and :170, an unexpected read has no assertion backstop, so a regression that reads production through a method outside the allowlist passes this test silently.
